digest.component_or_area: gate evaluation framework / defect detection measurement
propositions: Deterministic seeded-defect benchmark infrastructure (mutant corpus, pre-registered thresholds, mutation-assembly and benchmark driver, pure counting helpers, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally not landed on main.

Five defect classes are mechanically seeded into real cleanly-closed plans to construct known ground truth for detection and false-positive measurement: absent-capability, layer-cake-split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary-mechanism, and untagged-operational-AC.

The ~100-run live LLM batch baseline (current-gate sweep over mutant/control corpus producing e2_baseline.json, e2_run_validity.json, e2_verdicts.jsonl) was permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder operating at zero marginal LLM cost on production reviews.

Store isolation is implemented by construction: the harness clones the store as a standalone git repository (own .git directory, not linked worktree) to prevent contamination of the real ticket tracker.
History-based baseline mining is dead: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed; impact_model_version bump stranded the historical data.

The pure counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) handle PASS/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE verdicts with a ≥0.20 INDETERMINATE run-validity cap enforced by emit_baseline guard, verified by golden and synthetic offline tests without LLM execution.
